valuation_note: Trailing P/S is the provider-reported equity price-to-sales multiple, not EV/sales, forward sales, backlog or recurring revenue. All source pages were observed 2026-11-26 and display a 2026-11-25 regular close; individual financial inputs and ratios can update on different schedules. Seven published ratios are retained with company-specific qualifications; WYFI and AGPU are null because same-page capitalization / trailing revenue does not reconcile to published P/S. No missing ratio is zero. Fundamental ranking is appropriate only after matching business model, revenue scope, financial period, share basis and leverage; these nine are a research cohort, not nine interchangeable valuation peers. No cheapest-stock or buy ranking is implied. GPU cloud, landlord/hosting, mining/power and treasury transition businesses require different cash-flow models. TTM small revenue bases exaggerate early-stage multiples; announced capacity and contracted backlog are not recognized sales. Provider capitalization is not independently reconciled fully diluted equity.
